name: australian-productivity-compared
title: Australian productivity, compared
description: Australian labour productivity from Productivity Commission chart data, with international comparisons of GDP per hour worked from the OECD Productivity Database and ILOSTAT modelled estimates.

sources.title: Productivity Commission, Productivity update – September 2026 (chart data)
Productivity Commission, Quarterly productivity bulletin – June 2026 (chart data)
ILOSTAT, Output per hour worked (GDP constant 2021 international $ at PPP), ILO modelled estimates, SDMX ILO,DF_GDP_2HRW_NOC_NB,1.0

resources.name: au_labour_productivity_quarterly
resources.description: Quarterly labour productivity index (GDP per hour worked), seasonally adjusted, June 2014 = 100. Source: PC Sept 2026 update.

fields.name: quarter_end
fields.description: First day of the quarter's final month (PC convention), e.g. 2026-06-01 = June quarter 2026

resources.name: au_headline_change
resources.description: Quarterly and through-the-year % change in output, hours worked and labour productivity (whole economy). Source: PC Sept 2026 update dashboard; periods re-labelled because the workbook's labels are stale.

resources.name: au_industry_mfp_growth_2002_2024
resources.description: Cumulative multifactor productivity growth by market-sector industry, 2001-02 to 2023-24 (%). Source: PC June 2026 bulletin, Figure 1a.

resources.name: oecd_gdp_per_hour
resources.description: GDP per hour worked, total economy, chain-linked volumes in constant 2020 PPP US$ (OECD measure GDPHRS, USD_PPP_H, LR). pct_of_us is the ratio to the US in the same year.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-3 or OECD aggregate code

resources.name: ilo_gdp_per_hour
resources.description: Output per hour worked, GDP in constant 2021 international $ at PPP, ILO modelled estimates. Years after 2025 are projections (status=projection). Not directly comparable with the OECD series.

resources.name: oecd_extra_metrics
resources.description: Per-country extra metrics from the OECD Productivity Database: GDP per capita (constant PPP US$) and share of the US, hours worked per head of population, and growth-accounting contributions (percentage points per year) of MFP and capital deepening to labour productivity growth, averaged over 2015-19 and 2020-24 (or latest available year).

resources.name: growth_summary
resources.description: Compound average annual growth of GDP per hour worked between the endpoint years of each period, by source.
